# tfcensus config init

Writes a config file that lists every key commented out at its default, so the file
changes nothing until you uncomment a key. It goes to .tfcensus.yaml in the working
directory, to path, or with --user to the user file. The directory is created when it's missing.

An existing file is kept, with exit code 2, unless you pass --force. The written path goes
to stderr.

## Usage

```sh
tfcensus config init [path] [flags]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | no | no |

## Flags

| Flag | Description | Type | Default | Values | Config key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--force` | replace an existing file | bool |  |  |  |  |
| `--user` | write the user file instead of .tfcensus.yaml | bool |  |  |  |  |

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Output formats

This command ignores `--format`.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The command finished. With --fail-on, nothing matched. |
| 1 | The command failed: a read, a write, a child process or a check failed. |
| 2 | Wrong usage: an unknown command or flag, a bad value or argument, an invalid config file, or a prompt with no terminal. |
| 130 | Interrupted by Ctrl-C (SIGINT) or a cancelled context. |

All codes are listed on the [exit codes](/reference/exit-codes) page.

## Examples

```sh
tfcensus config init
tfcensus config init --user
tfcensus config init ci/tfcensus.yaml --force
```
